the_ceiling_question.owner_asked: verify every proposed completion respects the fee-inclusive $0.96 ceiling
the_ceiling_question.finding: THE PREMISE DOES NOT MATCH THE ENGINE, BY DESIGN. COMPLETION_CEILINGS_IN_FORCE is ('improves','within_budget') and DELIBERATELY EXCLUDES pair_cap. The source states why: pair_cap is the OPENING discipline; on the four windows of 2026-10-28 it bound in every case while improves permitted the whole grid, and 1245z stranded 2.27 UP for -$0.7264 where a 0.97 pair would have left the book near flat.
the_ceiling_question.where_the_hard_limit_actually_is: pair_cost_refusal at the SUBMISSION boundary. Openings answer to 0.96 (TS.max_pair_cost()). A completion of confirmed residual inventory answers to completion_pair_rescue, which requires ALL THREE: it must reduce an unmatched position (held[other] > held[side]); it must not cross zero (after[side] <= held[other]); and eff <= 1.00. A defensive mandate has its own looser 1.20 ceiling for the exact order it names.
the_ceiling_question.so_a_0_99_cap_is_largely_ALREADY_IMPLEME: completion_pair_rescue's eff <= 1.00, gated on reduce-not-cross, is a stranded-only ceiling that is structurally tighter than a flat 0.99 because it also forbids crossing zero and increasing exposure.

measured_against_the_boundary.worked_example: 2230z held UP 2.04 at 0.9588 (0.47/unit). The complement DOWN's own touch walked 0.62 -> 0.91 as DOWN became likely, so every proposed reprice implies eff 1.09 to 1.45 -- a certain loss, correctly refused.

what_enabling_it_would_actually_do.ordering: maybe_completion_requote CANCELS ONLY and submits nothing. The replacement is placed by the ordinary complement path on a later tick, where acc_leg_attempt charges the REPLACE budget and refuses outright while any order is live -- which is what makes two competing completion orders structurally impossible.
what_enabling_it_would_actually_do.net_effect_on_the_four_real_windows: 38 cancel requests, 0 admissible replacements, and the resting complement lost. The window ends with NO resting completion where it previously had one.
what_enabling_it_would_actually_do.but_it_costs_nothing_economically_here: on 2230z the resting complement sat at own 0.47 and would only have filled if DOWN's own price FELL back to 0.47. It rose to 0.91 and the window settled DOWN, so that order was never going to fill. Cancelling it loses nothing REAL in these windows -- it simply adds 38 cancel requests for no completion.
what_enabling_it_would_actually_do.which_is_the_owner_s_own_stated_anti_goa: the objective is not more cancel requests; it is more safely confirmed, profitable pair completions. On this evidence the requoter delivers the former and none of the latter.

why_the_disabled_switch_was_NOT_the_bloc: the hypothesis was that L5_COMPLETION_REQUOTE being off is what cost us the pairs. On the four venue-confirmed states it would have changed no economic outcome: every reprice it proposes is refused at submission for buying a certain loss, because the book had already walked past the point where any pair under $1.00 existed. The blocker was the adverse first-leg fill, not the frozen complement.
